title: Privacy, fairness & explanations
summary: Investigating trade-offs in an Adult-income classification pipeline.
overview: A team study combines classification with privacy, fairness and local explanations.
constraints: Protected attributes, randomized-response noise and fairness mitigation affect one another.
contribution: A six-person academic project. The case describes the team pipeline while the individual allocation is being reconstructed.
approach: The earlier portfolio describes logistic regression, reweighing, local differential privacy and LIME/MACE analysis.
results: The team’s previous portfolio records comparisons between baseline, private and mitigated models.
limits: Dataset splits and reported metrics need to be reconciled before numerical claims are used. Statistical fairness measures are specific to their definitions and evaluation populations.
